decisions.summary: One module _plan_gate.py holds every gate decision; tick-task.py, plan-gate.sh and make plan-verdict call it
decisions.why: Implementation structure for FR-001, FR-005 to FR-008; it narrows no requirement.

decisions.summary: plan-gate.sh runs from sync-with-main.sh directly after review-gate.sh, escape first, on entry-gate.sh's shape
decisions.why: FR-007 says beside review-gate.sh and FR-008 requires the logged escape; the escape skips only what FR-008 already permits.

decisions.summary: Around the pieces: agent-file mode, template first task, PLAN_REVIEW_OK in the escape census, a CLAUDE.md guard-table row, make docs
decisions.why: FR-009 and FR-010 directly; the census row and guard-table row are the project's standing obligations for a new escape and guard, not new scope.

decisions.summary: Digest is SHA-256 of plan.md bytes taken when the reviewer starts; make plan-verdict refuses a mismatched digest at record time
decisions.why: Applies FR-004's byte-identity at the moment of recording too; it only refuses more, never lets a stale review through.

decisions.summary: Verdict derived from rulings; input whose verdict disagrees, a narrowing without ruling, a within with ruling or an unknown class is refused; no decisions records CLEAR
decisions.why: FR-003 defines CLEAR/BLOCKED from the rulings and FR-002 gives rulings to narrowing decisions only; an empty list satisfies 'no narrowing decision ruled NOT LEGITIMATE'.

decisions.summary: plan-review.json fields: feature, plan_sha256, reviewed date, declared, decisions (id, summary, class, ruling for narrowing only, why), verdict
decisions.why: Carries every field FR-003 requires plus the declaration FR-006 records.

decisions.summary: A ticked task is a column-0 '- [x] ' line (either case); indented research boxes are not counted
decisions.why: tick-task.py writes and matches column-0 task lines, no tasks.md at this commit has an indented T-line (git grep: 0 files), and a research box is a sub-item of its task, so FR-007's 'ticked task' is read as written rather than narrowed.

decisions.summary: Push gate takes touched specs/NNN-*/ dirs from git diff --name-only <range> and reads tasks.md, plan.md, plan-review.json at HEAD via git show
decisions.why: FR-007 names review-gate.sh check 1's set, which is derived the same way (review-gate.sh line 49/70); HEAD is what the push lands.

decisions.summary: PLAN_REVIEW_OK read from the environment in both places, exported by make tick, reason floor via _hm_escape.py, logged to guard log and bypass-log; per-refusal rule slugs
decisions.why: FR-008's escape with required, logged reason; environment reading is the existing census class and makes a mention unable to escape.

decisions.summary: tests/tooling/test_plan_gate.py plus scripts/test-plan-gate.sh companion suite; every refusal mutation-proven
decisions.why: Serves SC-001 to SC-008; no requirement is narrowed.

decisions.summary: This plan is reviewed via prompt-given mode instructions while implementation proceeds; recorded through make plan-verdict once it exists; no task ticked before gate and record exist; re-reviewed if the plan changes
decisions.why: The gate governs ticking, not implementation, and SC-009 requires exactly that ticks follow the gate and this plan's review; no tick is exempted.

decisions.summary: XVI, XVIII, X clause 13 and escape doctrine restated as satisfied
decisions.why: States compliance; makes no decision that changes scope.
